result.png.shows: the known-good artifact's equity curve against the blind reference's final equity (the G2 oracle agreement), with the drawdown and position panels
result.png.source_data: media/data/series.json + media/data/metrics.json (the judge's own blind reference run)

loop.png.shows: the agent-loop replay's judge-measured deviation per attempt until the judge passes, and the self-test kill rate per known-bad mutant
loop.png.source_data: media/data/replay.json + media/data/selftest.json (grade verdicts of the known-bad mutants and the good artifact)

demo.mp4.shows: the same series animated: the backtest running day by day, the agent loop's deviations, then the kill rates
demo.mp4.command: media/make_media.sh -> media/make_video.py + ffmpeg (crf 0 lossless master in media/master/, then -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart)
demo.mp4.source_data: media/frames rendered by make_video.py from media/data/*.json

source_data.series: media/data/series.json (the judge's own blind reference equity/position/drawdown series)
source_data.replay: media/data/replay.json (the known-bad mutants graded in the order a fixing agent would meet them)
